title: ₹1 Doubled Every Day for 30 Days! 💰
description:
Would you take ₹1 that doubles every day for 30 days?

Day 1 is ₹1, day 2 is ₹2, day 3 is ₹4 and day 10 is just ₹512, which sounds disappointing. But day 20 is more than ₹5 lakh, day 25 is more than ₹1.6 crore, and day 30 is ₹53.7 crore. That's the power of exponential growth: something that starts incredibly small becomes unbelievably large when it keeps doubling.

📌 Quick facts
• Day 1: ₹1, Day 10: ₹512
• Day 20: ₹5,24,288 (more than ₹5 lakh)
• Day 25: ₹1,67,77,216 (more than ₹1.6 crore)
• Day 30: ₹53,68,70,912 (about ₹53.7 crore)
Figures are approximate and rounded.
